page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre "LIBER I." with page number "457" at top right. Below the head, a framed woodcut diagram of the zones (ORIENS, OCCASVS, MERIDIES, SEPTENTRIO around the frame, with zone labels inside an oval and the ecliptic with zodiac signs). Below the woodcut, two columns of running text, the left one partly cut off at the edge of the scan, ending in a line continuing to the right.

main_text.l: ZONA TEMPERATA AVS: Tropicus Capricorni siue hybernus.
main_text.p: Tantum de dimensione & distinctione globi terreni per Zonas: sequitur dimensio & distinctio eiusdem globi terreni per Climata.
Est autem Clima spacium globi terreni comprehensum inter duos parallelos versus eundem polum ab æquatore distantes, atq; adeo inclusum

page.notes: The left column of text is cut off at the left edge of the scan; its first letters are missing (shown above as they are visible, e.g. "terreni", "prehensum", "polum"). The diagram's zodiac signs and the word "Æquinoctialis" are partly overprinted and hard to read; the labels are transcribed as best read. The text fragment "fum" at the end of the last line is printed on the right, separated from the line above.
